**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve classified outcomes before publication failures**

When the model response has already been parsed and classified but the subsequent head re-read or `publishReview` call fails, the finding result exists even though the review is not public. This rule instead assigns `not_determined` to every pre-publication failure and only preserves `produced_findings`/`produced_none` after `reviewPublished`, contradicting AC1's definition that `not_determined` applies only while the result is unestablished. Track whether classification completed independently of publication, and test the existing post-parse GitHub calls failing before publication.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
